evidence.title: Roomote website
evidence.finding: Source-available self-hosted cloud coding agent from the Roo Code team; harness stated as OpenCode; pricing: free up to 10 users, 11-50 users $249/mo, 51-100 users $499/mo, 100+ custom; user pays hosting, sandbox and inference providers; always single-tenant.

evidence.title: How Roomote works

evidence.title: How a deployment runs

evidence.finding: Request creates or resumes a session; tasks run in isolated sandboxes; web dashboard is the configuration and review surface; automations start repeatable sessions.

evidence.title: Run your first task

evidence.title: Sessions

evidence.finding: Sessions keep conversation, delegated tasks, artifacts, PRs, cost and unread state; list and board with Active/Needs input/Blocked/Ready/Done lanes; stop/archive/delete; wakeups (max 10 per session); queued follow-ups; completion webhook; private sessions experimental.

evidence.title: Review a task
evidence.locator: Sessions and task status; Attention notifications; Safety stops; Task view; Continuing work
evidence.finding: Task view with transcript, logs, diffs, previews, artifacts; attention notifications through chat or email; safety stops (5 identical tool calls, 20-minute subagents, 1,000 provider-request ceiling); snapshot-based resume; Judgement pre-commit rules.

evidence.title: Sandboxes overview
evidence.locator: Supported providers table; Local Docker versus hosted
evidence.finding: Providers: Docker, Modal, E2B, Daytona, Blaxel, Box, Azure (preview); one workspace per task; Docker shares the Roomote host.

evidence.title: Docker sandbox provider
evidence.finding: Per-task dedicated bridge network; defaults 2 CPU, 4 GiB, 512 PIDs, 20 GiB writable layer; restricted socket proxy; stopped containers retained for resume.

evidence.title: Users

evidence.title: Roomote v1.25.0 privacy docs and analytics gate
evidence.locator: apps/docs/privacy.mdx intro, 'Managed deployment controls' and 'Version checks'; apps/web/src/lib/server/auth-context.ts authorize() (anonymousAnalyticsEnabled, line ~410); apps/web/src/components/layout/TelemetryProvider.tsx

The daily version check reads GitHub's public API with no instance ID, version or usage data.

evidence.title: Roomote v1.25.0 telemetry gates (bounded source search)
evidence.locator: packages/telemetry/src/server/index.ts isAnonymousAnalyticsEnabled (lines 150-159), captureEvent, captureTaskSettled, sendInstanceReport, submitPlatformIssueToPing; apps/web/src/app/api/telemetry/route.ts; apps/web/src/lib/server/setup-funnel-telemetry.ts; apps/web/src/components/layout/RootProviders.tsx (CloudConsentGate only when cloudEnabled); apps/api, apps/worker, apps/controller monitoring/sentry.ts; apps/web/src/instrumentation-client.ts. Terms: posthog, sentry, segment, amplitude, mixpanel, intercom, telemetry, analytics, R_PING_BASE_URL, excluding node_modules and tests.
evidence.finding: At tag v1.25.0 isAnonymousAnalyticsEnabled is true only when R_CLOUD_ENABLED marks a Roomote Cloud deployment (code comment: self-hosted deployments never send analytics); event capture, task-settled events, the instance report, the setup funnel and the browser telemetry route all check it, and the PostHog and Intercom consent gate renders only on Cloud. Sentry in the web, API, worker and controller services initialises only with a DSN the operator sets (SENTRY_DSN and service-specific variables, all optional). The only other call to ping.roomote.dev is submitPlatformIssueToPing, sent when an admin clicks to submit a specific platform-issue report. No PostHog, Segment, Amplitude or Mixpanel client runs on a self-hosted deployment.
